svg.aria-label: A 3x3 Grover circuit: what its cost is made of. Routing is not a constant: it costs 10,789 on top of the dearer synthesis and 1,845 on top of the cheaper one. FakeTorino (133 q, heavy-hex, basis cz/id/rz/sx/x), optimization level 3, qiskit 2.4.1. A fit to a device model, not a run on hardware. The oracle is written from the clues and compiled into one marked grid per solution, so every quantum figure is a lower bound.

g.text: stipple: SWAP routing onto the lattice
The same circuit, one compiler decision apart: 5.97x the gates, 7.91x the depth, at nine
qubits. The gap widens with the gate: one of c controls costs 6(c-1) with a qubit to borrow
